# Setup
```{r}
#Housekeeping
rm(list = ls())
graphics.off()

#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(skimr)
library(reshape2)
library(GPArotation)
library(psy)
library(plotrix)
library(FactoMineR)
library(tidytext)
```


```{r}
#load in data
demo <- read_csv("../data/scales/participants.csv")

d <- read_csv("../data/scales/trials.csv")

pca1 <- read_csv("pca_1_dim.csv")
pca2 <- read_csv("pca_2_dim.csv")
pca3 <- read_csv("pca_3_dim.csv")

em1 <- read_csv("../results/embedding_1d.csv")
em2 <- read_csv("../results/embedding_2d.csv")
em3 <- read_csv("../results/embedding_3d.csv")
```

```{r}
scales <- tibble(
  scale_id = c("strictness", "theory_practical", "assim_direct", "broadness"),
  low = c("loose", "theoretical", "assimilated knowledge", "specific"),
  high = c("strict", "practical", "direct evidence", "broad")
)
```
```{r}
cat("We have data from", nrow(demo), "participants\n")
```

```{r}
d <- d %>% 
  mutate(
    response_align = if_else(scale_reversed == TRUE, response*(-1), response)
  )
```

```{r}
d <- d %>% 
  mutate(response_align_scaled = ((response_align + 200) * 1)/400)
```

```{r}
d_sum <- d %>% 
  group_by(scale_id, word) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_rating = mean(response_align_scaled),
    sd_rating = sd(response_align_scaled),
    n = n(),
    se_rating = sd_rating/sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = avg_rating - 1.96 * se_rating,
    ci_upper = avg_rating + 1.96 * se_rating
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
d_sum <- d_sum %>% 
  left_join(scales, by = "scale_id")
```

```{r}
d_plot <- d_sum %>%
  mutate(word = reorder_within(word, avg_rating, scale_id))
```

```{r}
d_plot <- d_plot %>% 
  mutate(
    word_label = str_extract(word, "^[^_]+")
  )
```


# Plot ratings
```{r}
p_scales <- ggplot(d_plot, aes(y = avg_rating, x = word)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = avg_rating - se_rating,
        ymax = avg_rating + se_rating),
    height = 0.2,
    width = .2,
    color = "darkgrey"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "darkgrey") +
  facet_wrap(~ scale_id, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = word_label),
    #hjust = 1,
    #vjust = .5,
    nudge_y = 0.05,
    size = 4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = scales,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = low),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = -.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = scales,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = high),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = -.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 30),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    #strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines")
  )

p_scales
```
